name: Sweet Tears
source:
It's spring and love is in the air. Who will hero choose among friends to share these wonderful moments? Or maybe it will be mysterious transfer student?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
春天来了，空气中弥漫着爱的气息。英雄会在朋友中选择谁来分享这些美好的时刻呢？又或者是神秘的转校生？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
